source.title: [Parked] Automated Fee Collection & Tutor/Centre Payout Rails (FPS → Stripe Connect → Hold-until-Confirm)
source.body:
# [Parked] Automated Fee Collection & Tutor/Centre Payout Rails (FPS → Stripe Connect → Hold-until-Confirm)

> **RESOLVED 2026-10-25:** [#444](https://github.com/keyframesfound/matchmaxhk/issues/444) / [#469](https://github.com/keyframesfound/matchmaxhk/pull/469) merged — live ToS §15 = tutor-pays (`owed by the Tutor`; Customers and centres do not pay MatchMax a matching fee). Build/copy against tutor-pays; admin-fee automation gate on #444 is cleared for **payer identity** (other #475 phase gates still apply).

> **Payer lock:** Issues lock **tutor pays** 1.5-lesson admin (#464). Live ToS §15 now matches (see RESOLVED above). Build against tutor-pays. #475 Phase1 Collect Tuition (parent→tutor) remains available after `#459`/`#461A`; automated admin collection still waits on #475 phase gates (not on #444 identity).

> **Status: On Hold / Later — NOT V1 Urgent.**  
> Do **not** pull into the urgent set. Desk matching + `#459` / `#461A` / `#466` / `#467` ship first.  
> **Does not change** the tutor-pays **1.5-lesson** admin lock or **0% after L2** economics (#464).

## CEO locks (2026-10-25 — ADOPT; do not drift)

| # | Lock |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | **Phase 0 (now):** Manual FPS for MatchMax admin fee + notes-shop manual cashier. Keep shipping reminders / mark-paid; do **not** rebuild payment rails yet. |
| 2 | **Phase 1 (after `#459` + `#461A`):** **Collect Tuition** tool on tutor `/dashboard#earnings` (centres under `/business/`). Parent pays tutor via **FPS QR** and/or **Stripe Payment Link**. **MatchMax does not touch the money.** Completing payment updates the **Unpaid tuition** bucket only. |
| 3 | **Phase 2 (later):** **Stripe Connect** — tutors/centres as Connected Accounts; MatchMax may take `application_fee` only for admin L1/L2 where applicable; **tutor/centre is the payee**. Hong Kong supported — prefer Connect over inventing a MatchMax bank escrow. |
| 4 | **Phase 3 (later still):** **Delayed payout / hold-until-confirmed** (Stripe Connect delayed payout or similar) — **not** MatchMax corporate bank escrow. **HK solicitor + Cap.57 review REQUIRED** before any hold on tutoring tuition. |
| 5 | **NEVER** hold client tuition in MatchMax’s own bank account early. |
| 6 | **NEVER** become Merchant of Record (MoR) for ongoing L3+ tuition without counsel. |
| 7 | Do **not** change 1.5 / short-case 20% / **0% after L2** economics just to enable payments. |
| 8 | **Cap.57:** MatchMax = matching + **optional** payment tools. Tutors remain independent contractors. Not an employment agency; no EA licence. |
| 9 | Centres use the **same** collection flow under `/business/` (org payout account). |
| 10 | **Hours ledger ≠ payment status.** `#459` VerifiedHoursLedger writes from lesson complete / confirm; unpaid/paid tuition is a separate money state on `#461`. |

---

## Critical conflict — document before any public automation

| Source | Who pays MatchMax **admin** fee (1.5) today / as locked |
| --- | --- |
| **Live** [ToS §15](https://matchmax.hk/en/tos) (post-[#469](https://github.com/keyframesfound/matchmaxhk/pull/469)) + guides | **Tutor pays** MatchMax admin by FPS (`owed by the Tutor`). Customers/centres do **not** pay MatchMax a matching fee; Customer pays Tutor directly for tuition. |
| **CEO / issues** `#464` · `#444` · `#461` · `#467` · PRODUCT.md | **Tutor pays** matching admin (B2C + B2B). Parents/centres do **not** pay MatchMax matching fees. Short ≤5 → 20% of package. |

**Gate (updated 2026-10-25):** [#444](https://github.com/keyframesfound/matchmaxhk/issues/444) / [#469](https://github.com/keyframesfound/matchmaxhk/pull/469) merged — live ToS §15 = **tutor-pays**; payer-identity conflict for admin fee is **cleared**. Phase 0/1 Collect Tuition (parent→tutor) can still ship after `#459`/`#461A`. Public automated **admin-fee** checkout still waits on remaining #475 phase gates (Stripe/FPS rails, counsel for hold) — **this issue stays On Hold / not urgent**; do not unpark.

---

## A. Current commercial model map (who pays whom)

### Live product (website + code today)

| Money | From → To | When | Rail today |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Admin fee (1.5)** | Parent → MatchMax | After intro lessons / invoice (`fee_invoiced` → `fee_paid` in `sor.ts`) | Manual **FPS** + screenshot; staff mark paid (`#259` Fee desk). Reminders: `fee-reminder.tsx`. |
| L1 tutor pay | — | Tutor receives **$0** for L1 under live parent-pays model | N/A |
| L2 tutor share | Parent → Tutor | Remaining **50%** of L2 | Direct (off-platform) |
| L3+ tuition | Parent → Tutor | Ongoing Lesson Contract | Direct; MatchMax **does not** hold/process (ToS §5, §15) |
| Notes / freestyle | Buyer → MatchMax (seller of record) | Checkout | Manual FPS cashier (`#203`); 20% platform / 80% tutor monthly FPS payout |
| Notes escrow (planned) | Hold seller net 48–72h | After delivery | `#429` — **goods** escrow, seller-funded refunds only |
| Referral bounty | MatchMax → referrer | After referred tutor’s first fee-paid case | Monthly FPS |

**Code reality:** `fee-breakdown.ts` / `sor.ts` = 1.5 math + SoR states. `checkout.functions.ts` = materials cashier. **No Stripe dependency** in `package.json`. Help `payment-methods.md` is still a draft stub.

### Locked destination (issues — do not reopen economics)

| Money | From → To | Rule |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Admin fee** | **Tutor → MatchMax** | 1.5 lessons (L1 100% + L2 50%); short ≤5 = 20% package; pro-bono $0 = 0 (`#464`) |
| L3+ tuition | Parent → Tutor | **0%** MatchMax cut — lock-in thesis (`#467`) |
| Unpaid tuition bucket | Parent **owes tutor** | Never conflate with admin fee (`#461` Phase A) |
| Phones | After fee paid | `#255` |

---

## B. Gaps vs Airbnb / Taobao ambition

| Airbnb / Taobao / eBay | MatchMax today | Gap |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Hosted checkout | Manual FPS + WA | No auto capture / webhook |
| Platform holds then releases | Only planned for **notes** (`#429`) | Tutoring tuition explicitly **not** held (ToS §5) |
| Connected payouts | Monthly FPS statements for notes | No Connect accounts for tutors/centres |
| Lesson complete → pay | Desk / WA | Needs `#461A` session writer + unpaid bucket first |
| Trust / escrow on first deal | Human concierge | Hold-until-confirm = Phase 3 + solicitor |

Ambition is valid; **path = tools for both parties**, not “MatchMax becomes the bank.”

---

## C. Phased carry-out (ADOPT — do not compress)

### Phase 0 — Now (V1 ops; keep)

- Manual FPS admin-fee collection + `#259` mark-paid + fee reminders.
- Notes shop manual cashier (`#203`); escrow hold stays on `#429` (goods only).
- Automate **invoicing reminders** and tie “lesson complete → invoice / unpaid” signals from `#461A` when it lands — still **no** new payment processor.
- Finish `#444` legal rewrite in parallel (unblock public honesty).

### Phase 1 — After `#459` + `#461A` (Tuition Collection Tool)

**What:** Optional **Collect tuition** on `/dashboard#earnings` (tutor) and `/business/` (centre).

- Generate **FPS QR** (tutor’s own FPS ID) and/or **Stripe Payment Link** pointing at the tutor’s Stripe account / Payment Link (tutor-owned; MatchMax does not receive funds).
- Parent pays → tutor/centre marks received **or** webhook on Payment Link paid → **Unpaid tuition** bucket clears for that lesson.
- MatchMax **does not** touch money; **0%** rail fee in Phase 1 (convenience tool only). Tiny rail fee optional later — product decision, not economics change to 1.5.
- Hours ledger still from lesson complete / dual confirm (`#459`) — **independent** of paid/unpaid.

**Acceptance (Phase 1)**

- [ ] Tutor/centre can create a payment request tied to a logged lesson / unpaid row
- [ ] FPS QR uses tutor/centre FPS identifier stored on payout profile
- [ ] Stripe Payment Link path uses tutor-owned Stripe (no MatchMax destination)
- [ ] Unpaid bucket updates; admin-fee state untouched
- [ ] Cap.57 / independent-tutor disclaimer on the Collect UI
- [ ] No MatchMax bank account in the flow

### Phase 2 — Later (Stripe Connect)

- Tutors/centres onboard as **Stripe Connect** Connected Accounts (HK).
- For **admin fee** (post-`#444` tutor-pays): charge path where MatchMax is paid via `application_fee_amount` / destination charge as counsel advises — **tutor remains commercial party to tuition**; admin fee identity follows Fee Agreement.
- For **ongoing tuition**: prefer **direct charges to Connected Account** (tutor payee) with MatchMax as platform; **0%** or tiny listed rail fee; **never** silent take of L3+.
- Centres: one Connected Account per Organisation; multi-seat / class packs = Phase 4 flavour of same rail.

**Acceptance (Phase 2)**

- [ ] Connect onboarding + payout profile on dashboard / business portal
- [ ] Webhook: `payment_intent.succeeded` / `checkout.session.completed` → mark lesson tuition paid
- [ ] Admin-fee automation only after `#444` live
- [ ] Reconciliation export for ops
- [ ] Solicitor memo filed on Connect + Cap.57 before go-live

### Phase 3 — Later still (Hold-until-confirm)

- **Delayed payout** on Connected Account (or Stripe hold products) until parent/tutor confirms L1 (or N hours) — **not** parking funds in MatchMax Ltd / sole-prop bank.
- Mirror notes-shop anti-scam intent (`#429`) for **first lesson / new tutors** only; do **not** default-hold all L3+ volume.
- **Solicitor + Cap.57 + payment-services review REQUIRED** before any tutoring-tuition hold ships.
- ToS §5 today forbids receiving/safeguarding tuition — must be rewritten with affirmative Fee / Payment Facility acceptance before enablement.

### Phase 4 — Centres / packs (after Phase 2)

- Multi-seat attendance + prepaid package burn-down (`#461` Phase B) collecting via same Connect rail.
- Class packs / centre invoices; still org Connected Account as payee.

### Explicit non-goals (early)

- ❌ MatchMax bank escrow for all ongoing tuition  
- ❌ Becoming MoR for L3+ without counsel  
- ❌ Changing 1.5 / 0%-after-L2 to “justify” payments  
- ❌ Replacing `#255` phones gate with “pay anything”  
- ❌ Vacancy/job payment flows (`#413` Cap.57 parked)  

---

## D. Stripe vs FPS vs hybrid (HK recommendation)

| Rail | Use for | Pros | Cons |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **FPS (manual → QR)** | Phase 0–1 default; HK parents already use it | Zero FX; familiar; matches ToS/cashier today | No rich webhook unless bank API; staff/tutor confirm needed |
| **Stripe Payment Links** | Phase 1 optional card/FPS-via-Stripe where tutor has Stripe | Fast to ship; tutor-owned | Tutor must have Stripe; fees on tutor side |
| **Stripe Connect** | Phase 2+ platform automation | Proper marketplace pattern; `application_fee`; delayed payout options | Onboarding friction; counsel; HK Connect product limits to verify at build time |
| **PayMe / other** | Optional later | Local UX | Extra integration; don’t block Phase 1 |

**Recommendation:** **Hybrid.** Keep FPS as primary HK path forever for parents who won’t card-pay. Add Stripe Connect when volume and `#461` logging make automation ROI clear. Do **not** rip out FPS cashier for notes until Connect escrow for goods is designed (`#429`).

---

## E. Cap.57 / EA / money-handling warnings (honest)

1. MatchMax **does not** hold an Employment Agency licence (`#412` / `#413` / ToS §1). Matching is limited to **independent** tutors / Contract for Services.  
2. **Holding parent tuition in MatchMax’s own account** looks closer to safeguarding client money + intermediary control of the Lesson Contract — highest legal risk; **forbidden in Phase 0–2**.  
3. **Optional payment tools** where funds go **tutor/centre Connected Account** (or tutor FPS) keep MatchMax as matching platform + software — lower risk **if** copy, Fee Agreements, and independence language stay clean.  
4. **MoR for ongoing tuition** (MatchMax sells “lessons” and pays tutors as suppliers) is a different business — counsel before any experiment.  
5. Notes-shop escrow (`#429`) is **goods** marketplace with MatchMax as seller of record — do **not** copy-paste that pattern onto tutoring tuition without a separate legal memo.  
6. Automating admin-fee collection under the **wrong public payer story** (live parent-pays vs locked tutor-pays) is a compliance + trust bug — **`#444` first**.

---

## F. Dependencies & links

| Issue | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `#444` · `#464` | Payer identity + ToS; **blocks public admin-fee automation** |
| `#459` | Hours ledger foundation |
| `#461` · `#467` | Unpaid bucket, session writer, 0% after L2 loop |
| `#259` | Fee desk (Phase 0) |
| `#255` | Phones after fee — unchanged by tuition tool |
| `#203` · `#429` | Notes cashier + goods escrow (separate from tutoring rails) |
| `#465` · `#412` | Centres / Cap.57 org lane |
| `#473` | Promo / liability language when payment facility launches |

---

## G. Acceptance (epic-level)

- [ ] Phase labels respected; nothing marked `urgent` from this epic alone  
- [ ] Phase 1 ships only after `#459` + `#461A` usable daily  
- [ ] Phase 2 admin-fee auto-charge only after `#444` live on site  
- [ ] No MatchMax-bank hold of tutoring tuition in any phase without solicitor sign-off + ToS Payment Facility section  
- [ ] Tutor and centre UX parity (dashboard vs `/business/`)  
- [ ] Ledger hours and tuition paid flags never collapsed into one field  

---

## H. Wireframe (Phase 1 Collect — sketch)

```
/dashboard#earnings
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Unpaid tuition (owed to you)     HK$ 1,200  │
│  • Case MM-1042 · L3 · 22 Oct · $400        │
│    [ Collect via FPS QR ] [ Stripe Link ]   │
│  • Case MM-0988 · L5 · 21 Oct · $800        │
│    [ Mark received ]                        │
│ ⚠ MatchMax does not hold this money.        │
│   You are an independent tutor (Cap.57).    │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
